observations: Two photos show solar panels stacked inside a shipping container.
The panels have a white frame and dark blue/black photovoltaic cells arranged in a grid.
Photo 0 shows multiple panels stacked, one leaning forward; a person in red is partially visible at the bottom left.
Photo 1 shows a single panel leaning against the container wall, with a person in red and black clothing standing to the left.
A watermark 'OBITECH SOLAR ENERGY' is visible across both photos.
No brand or model label is visible on the panels in either photo.
